title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30264: add and extend events in CalcBestDirectUnitCost
summary: Two new integration events and an extended existing event provide customization points in purchase price selection logic, allowing subscribers to override minimum-quantity checks, best-price selection rules, and no-price fallback handling without duplicating internal loops.
key_points: OnCalcBestDirectUnitCostOnAfterIsInMinQty event lets subscribers override per-price minimum-quantity logic
OnCalcBestDirectUnitCostOnBeforeCaseStatement event allows replacing best-price selection rules with IsHandled skip flag
OnCalcBestDirectUnitCostOnBeforeNoPriceFound extended with SKU-related parameters for fallback cost interception
Events expose PurchasePrice record and related state to reduce need for logic re-implementation
Supports per-price-record customization in codeunit 7010 without modifying core loops
